+@traced
+def reduce_pair(c, task, idx):
+    """Thread ``idx``'s column pair of token idx / 64."""
+    s, tp = c["S"], c["d"].tp
+    a = c["args"]
+    if idx < s * RED_COLS // 2:
+        t = idx // (RED_COLS // 2)
+        col = task * RED_COLS + 2 * (idx % (RED_COLS // 2))
+        own = preg(c["sym"], c["ffn_off"], "ffn")
+        acc0, acc1 = sum_partials(
+            c["poll"], own, lambda src: region_pair(src, t, s, col), tp
+        )
+        bo.buffer_store(acc0.to(fx.BFloat16), rsrc(a["out"]), t * HIDDEN + col)
+        bo.buffer_store(acc1.to(fx.BFloat16), rsrc(a["out"]), t * HIDDEN + col + 1)
+
+
+def moe_smem(s, rs, timeline):
+    """The MoE stages' LDS (``timeline``: with its own stamp record)."""
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        # an ug task's partial C: 2 tiles a wave (``ug_red_slot``)
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 2 * WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+        tab: fx.Array[fx.Int32, rs.tab_words, 16]
+        pair: fx.Array[fx.Float32, ROWS * s, 16]
+        # one stage's buffers at a time (``stage_lds``)
+        stage: fx.Array[fx.Int32, sum(stage_lds(s, rs)["words"].values()), 16]
+        tls: fx.Array[fx.Int64, TL_POINTS if timeline else 1, 16]
+
+    return Smem
+
+
+def stage_lds(s, rs):
+    """Word offsets into ``Smem.stage`` of the buffers only one stage reads: the
+    shared stage's MXFP8 x tile; the waves' scale blocks (``wsl``, the ug and
+    down stages'), then the ug stage's routed MXFP8 x tile, or the down stage's
+    token tile of the shared expert's MXFP8 intermediate (``load_smid_tile``),
+    each down task's routed contributions (``contrib_store``) and its shared
+    expert rows (``down_shared``). A barrier ends every stage."""
+    d = rs.dims
+    # the x tile the shared / ug stages hold (every token's up to one tile)
+    rows = tile_rows(s)
+    x8 = rows * lds_row(X8_WORDS)
+    groups = rows * lds_row(HIDDEN // 32)
+    wsl = WAVES * wsl_words(d)
+    shared_xl = rows * lds_row(d.sh_inter // 4) + lds_tail(d.sh_inter)
+    shared_xsl = rows * lds_row(d.sh_inter // 32)
+    contrib = 2 * rs.picks * 16  # two down tasks' at most
+    offsets = {
+        "x8l": 0,
+        "x8sl": x8,
+        "wsl": 0,
+        "x8rl": wsl,
+        "x8rsl": wsl + x8,
+        "shared_xl": wsl,
+        "shared_xsl": wsl + shared_xl,
+        "contrib": wsl + shared_xl + shared_xsl,
+        "sdl": wsl + shared_xl + shared_xsl + contrib,
+    }
+    words = {
+        "shared": x8 + groups,
+        "ug": wsl + x8 + groups,
+        "down": wsl + shared_xl + shared_xsl + contrib + 2 * s * ROWS,
+    }
+    return {"offsets": offsets, "words": {"all": max(words.values())}}
+
+
+def moe_context(s, rs, lds, mb, bases, layout, scratch, args, rank, sym):
+    """The MoE stages' context: LDS, mailbox, scratch regions, arguments. Its lane
+    math starts from a ``fresh`` thread id: in K2 it is not the attention and
+    seam stages', held from theirs on."""
+    tid = fresh(fx.thread_idx.x)
+    c = {
+        "S": s,
+        "tid": tid,
+        "bid": fx.block_idx.x,
+        "lane": tid % 64,
+        "wave": tid // 64,
+        "red": lds.red.ptr,
+        "tab": lds.tab.ptr,
+        "pair": lds.pair.ptr,
+        "put": mb.put,
+        "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+        "put_words": mb.put_words,
+        "poll": mb.poll,
+        "tag": mb.tag,
+        "peer_addr": lambda p: bases[p],
+        "rank": rank,
+        "sym": sym,
+        "ffn_off": ffn_offset(s, rs.tp),
+        "rs": rs,
+        "d": rs.dims,
+        "args": args,
+        # x (``ffn_normed``) before this launch: plain loads, no readiness wait
+        "x_cm": 0,
+        "x_ready": False,
+    }
+    for name, off in stage_lds(s, rs)["offsets"].items():
+        c[name] = lds.stage.ptr + off
+    for region, (off, _) in layout.items():
+        c[region] = sreg(scratch, off, region)
+    return c
+
+
+@traced
+def run_moe(c, key, bid, tls, tl0):
+    """The MoE stages, in order; ``timeline`` stamps from point ``tl0`` + 1."""
+    s, timeline, tid = key.tokens, key.timeline, c["tid"]
+    router_tasks = c["rs"].router_tasks
+    route0, shared0 = c["rs"].route0, c["rs"].shared0
+    shared_tasks = c["d"].shared_tasks
+    ug_tasks = c["rs"].max_u * c["rs"].ug_parts
+    for t in range(first_task(bid, XQ0), s, BLOCKS):
+        await_x(c, [t])
+        stage_xq(c, t)
+        publish(c["put"], c["x8rdy"], t, 1, tid == 0)
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 1)
+    multi = len(token_tiles(s)) > 1
+    for task in range(first_task(bid, c["rs"].router0), router_tasks, BLOCKS):
+        await_x(c, list(range(s)))
+        stage_router(c, task)
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 2)
+    for t in range(first_task(bid, route0), s, BLOCKS):
+        stage_route(c, t)
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 3)
+    c["xl"], c["xsl"] = c["x8l"], c["x8sl"]
+    # a CTA's one shared unit (task, token tile) at most: straight-line code,
+    # whose tile loads LLVM does not hoist into one live set as it would out of
+    # a task loop (spills). A task's tiles in series on one CTA put three tiles'
+    # latency on the path down waits on (the weights read again a tile: L2 hits)
+    assert c["rs"].shared_units <= BLOCKS
+    unit = first_task(bid, shared0)
+    if unit < c["rs"].shared_units:
+        # the gate weights in flight before x's wait
+        a = c["args"]
+        gops = gemv_fp8_loads(
+            c, a["sgu"], a["sgu_s"], HIDDEN, unit % shared_tasks, row_major=True
+        )
+        if const_expr(not multi):
+            load_x8_rows(c, "x8", "x8s", c["x8l"], c["x8sl"], lambda j: j, s)
+            stage_shared(c, unit, gops, 0, s)
+        else:
+            t0 = unit // shared_tasks * TILE
+            n = fx.min(fx.Int32(TILE), s - t0)
+            load_x8_rows(c, "x8", "x8s", c["x8l"], c["x8sl"], lambda j: t0 + j, n)
+            stage_shared(c, unit % shared_tasks, gops, t0, n)
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 4)
+    c["xl"], c["xsl"] = c["x8rl"], c["x8rsl"]
+    if const_expr(multi):
+        # past one token tile a task gathers its pick tile's rows itself. The
+        # first round placed (the shared units' CTAs take its last tasks); the
+        # rest, past a round, from the queue: a CTA a shared or router task
+        # delayed takes fewer of them
+        load_route(c, c["tab"])
+        n_tiles = c["rs"].tile_first(c["tab"], c["rs"].n_union(c["tab"], s))
+        ug_total = mplan.ug_tasks(n_tiles, c["rs"].ug_parts)
+        task = first_task(bid, c["rs"].ug0)
+        while task < ug_total:
+            task = stage_ug_tile(c, task, ug_total)
+    else:
+        # one token tile: every task placed (its x in LDS once a CTA)
+        loaded = fx.Int32(0)
+        for task in range(first_task(bid, c["rs"].ug0), ug_tasks, BLOCKS):
+            if loaded == 0:
+                # X8R (ready long before the routing) first: after the routing
+                # lands only its own poll remains
+                load_x8_rows(c, "x8r", "x8rs", c["x8rl"], c["x8rsl"], lambda j: j, s)
+                load_route(c, c["tab"])
+            loaded = fx.Int32(1)
+            stage_ug(c, task)
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 5)
+    assert BLOCKS < DOWN_TASKS <= 2 * BLOCKS
+    # the route table is in LDS already past one token tile (every CTA loads it
+    # for the ug queue) or when every CTA ran an ug iteration (more ug task
+    # slots than CTAs), whose first loads it; else load it
+    if const_expr(not multi and ug_tasks <= BLOCKS):
+        load_route(c, c["tab"])
+    # every CTA its tile; the first DOWN_TASKS - BLOCKS to get here an extra
+    # one too: the CTAs whose ug ended first (by bid, those ending last held
+    # two tiles and ended the stage)
+    down_task = first_task(bid, DOWN0)
+    rank = take_down_rank(c)
+    if rank < DOWN_TASKS - BLOCKS:
+        stage_down(c, [down_task, BLOCKS + rank])
+    else:
+        stage_down(c, [down_task])
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 6)
+    for task in range(first_task(bid, RED0), RED_TASKS, BLOCKS):
+        stage_reduce(c, task)
+    stamp(timeline, tls, tid, tl0 + 7)
+
+
+def await_x(c, tokens):
+    """In a launch that also writes x (K2: the FFN seam's norm): tokens' rows
+    ready."""
+    if const_expr(c["x_ready"]):
+        c["poll"]([(c["xrdy"], t, 1) for t in tokens])
+
+
+def moe_args(*values) -> dict:
+    """The MoE stages' arguments by name, in ``ARGS`` order."""
+    assert len(values) == len(ARGS)
+    return dict(zip(ARGS, values))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+# Vendored from vllm-project/vllm @ 193922d6ff: vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/mono/stages/moe_plan.py
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at 97359d6, MIT License,

+# atom/models/deepseek_v41/mono/moe_plan.py
+"""Every per-step decision of which MoE ug flags (UGF) and intermediate rows
+(MID) the ug stage writes and the down stage reads, defined once.
+
+The route table (``stage_route``) gives each expert with picks a slot of U, its
+picks a run from ``slot_first``, and, past one token tile, its picks tiles of
+``TILE`` from ``tile_first`` (each tile's slot ``tile_slot``). An ug task covers
+a unit -- a slot, or past one token tile a pick tile -- and one of ``ug_parts`` parts
+of the intermediate; its flag is ``ug_flag``. A down round polls each of its
+slots' flags (``polled_tile`` its tiles) before it reads their MID rows. Called
+by the kernel on traced Int32 and by the CPU property test on Python ints.
+"""
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.plan.arith import cdiv, imin
+
+TILE = 16  # picks a pick tile: an MFMA's N
+
+
+def pick_tiles(count):
+    """A slot's pick tiles: its ``count`` picks, ``TILE`` a tile."""
+    return cdiv(count, TILE)
+
+
+def ug_parts(groups, ug_groups):
+    """A unit's ug parts: the expert's ``groups`` FP4 groups of its real width,
+    ``ug_groups`` a part. A part wholly in the padding is not run: MID's padded
+    columns stay the step's zeros, against zero weights in down."""
+    return cdiv(groups, ug_groups)
+
+
+def ug_flag(unit, part, ug_parts):
+    """The UGF pair of ug task (``unit``, ``part``), ``ug_parts`` parts a unit."""
+    return unit * ug_parts + part
+
+
+def ug_tasks(units, ug_parts):
+    """A step's ug tasks: every part of each of its ``units``."""
+    return units * ug_parts
+
+
+def tile_pick0(slot_first, tile, tile_first):
+    """Pick tile ``tile``'s first pick, its slot's picks from ``slot_first`` and
+    tiles from ``tile_first``."""
+    return slot_first + (tile - tile_first) * TILE
+
+
+def polled_tile(tile_first, tiles, j):
+    """The pick tile a down round polls as a slot's ``j``-th, the slot's
+    ``tiles`` tiles from ``tile_first``: the last past them."""
+    return tile_first + imin(j, tiles - 1)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Vendored from vllm-project/vllm @ 193922d6ff: vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/mono/stages/moe_shape.py
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at 97359d6, MIT License,
+# Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.:
+# atom/models/deepseek_v41/mono/kernels/moe_shape.py
+"""The MoE stages' build key and route shape: what they are built for (``MoeBuild``),
+and the task counts, placements and LDS route table that follow from its
+routing (``RouteShape``), with the table's readers. Plain Python but for the
+readers; the kernel's stages are in ``moe``."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.device.ops import WAVES
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.plan.execution import BLOCKS
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.stages import moe_plan as mplan
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.stages.dims import UG_PART, Dims
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.stages.gemv import (
+    ROWS,
+    TILE,
+    token_tiles,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.stages.router import (
+    PARTS as ROUTER_PARTS,
+)
+
+EXPERTS, TOPK = 384, 6  # the target's routing (a build's: ``MoeBuild``)
+ROUTER0 = 8  # the router's first task: past the xq tasks (a token each)
+MASK_WORDS = 2  # an expert's token bitmap in the route table: tokens <= 64
+# a route lane's experts (EXPERTS / 64) sorted descending, ties kept in index
+# order: the network by their count
+SORT_NETS = {
+    6: [
+        (0, 1),
+        (2, 3),
+        (4, 5),
+        (0, 2),
+        (1, 4),
+        (3, 5),
+        (0, 1),
+        (2, 3),
+        (4, 5),
+        (1, 2),
+        (3, 4),
+        (2, 3),
+    ],
+    2: [(0, 1)],
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MoeBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    # routed experts and a token's top-k: the target's, or the DSpark draft's
+    experts: int = EXPERTS
+    topk: int = TOPK
+    # the TP size: every width a rank holds (``Dims``)
+    tp: int = 4
+    timeline: bool = field(default=False, metadata={"sym": "tl"})
+    # FP4 groups an ug task (``RouteShape.ug_groups``)
+    ug_groups: int = 2
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RouteShape:
+    """A build's routing: ``experts`` routed experts, ``topk`` a token of
+    ``tokens``, the task counts and placements that follow, and the route table
+    ``load_route`` lays out in LDS: every token's (ids, weights), |U|, the
+    experts of U, each (t, k)'s slot in U, each expert's slot, the picks in slot
+    order and each slot's first position in it (past one token tile also each
+    slot's first pick tile and each pick tile's slot)."""
+
+    experts: int
+    topk: int
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int
+    # FP4 groups (32 intermediate columns) an ug task, its waves splitting K in
+    # halves (2) or quarters (1). 1 is twice the tasks, so the CTAs' ug ends
+    # closer together: faster at the draft's widths (40 rows -4 us), slower at
+    # the target's (48 rows +3 us; the runners pick)
+    ug_groups: int = 2
+
+    @property
+    def dims(self) -> Dims:
+        return Dims(self.tp)
+
+    @property
+    def ug_parts(self) -> int:
+        """An expert's ug tasks (``moe_plan.ug_parts``)."""
+        return mplan.ug_parts(self.dims.inter_real // UG_PART, self.ug_groups)
+
+    @property
+    def ug_k_slices(self) -> int:
+        """The K slices of an ug task's waves: a wave a (group, 16-column half,
+        slice)."""
+        return WAVES // (2 * self.ug_groups)
+
+    @property
+    def picks(self) -> int:
+        return self.tokens * self.topk
+
+    @property
+    def max_u(self) -> int:
+        return min(self.picks, self.experts)
+
+    @property
+    def router_groups(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """``stage_router``'s token groups and their tokens: a group a token
+        tile, as many as one round of CTAs holds (a CTA running two serialized
+        them: the route waited on the 32 that did at 48 rows)."""
+        per_group = self.experts // ROWS * ROUTER_PARTS
+        groups = max(1, min(len(token_tiles(self.tokens)), BLOCKS // per_group))
+        tokens = -(-self.tokens // groups)
+        assert (groups - 1) * tokens < self.tokens
+        return groups, tokens
+
+    @property
+    def router_tasks(self) -> int:
+        # (token group, 16-row tile, K part): ``stage_router``
+        return self.router_groups[0] * self.experts // ROWS * ROUTER_PARTS
+
+    @property
+    def router0(self) -> int:
+        """Past the xq tasks (a token each from CTA 0)."""
+        return max(ROUTER0, self.tokens)
+
+    @property
+    def route0(self) -> int:
+        return self.router0 + self.router_tasks
+
+    @property
+    def shared0(self) -> int:
+        return self.route0 + max(8, self.tokens)
+
+    @property
+    def shared_units(self) -> int:
+        """The shared expert's (task, token tile) units (``stage_shared``)."""
+        return self.dims.shared_tasks * len(token_tiles(self.tokens))
+
+    @property
+    def ug0(self) -> int:
+        """The first ug round's placement: the shared units' CTAs last."""
+        return self.shared0 + self.shared_units
+
+    @property
+    def sort_net(self):
+        return SORT_NETS[self.experts // 64]
+
+    @property
+    def tab_words(self) -> int:
+        return self.tile_slot0 + self.max_tiles if self.multi else self.queue0 + 1
+
+    @property
+    def multi(self) -> bool:
+        """More than one token tile: an ug task is a (tile of a slot's picks,
+        part) (``stage_ug``)."""
+        return self.tokens > TILE
+
+    @property
+    def slot_tiles(self) -> int:
+        """A slot's pick tiles at most (a token picks an expert once)."""
+        return len(token_tiles(self.tokens))
+
+    @property
+    def max_tiles(self) -> int:
+        """The pick tiles of U at most: a slot's partial tile each, then the
+        whole tiles, and never more than a tile a pick."""
+        return min(self.picks, self.max_u + self.picks // TILE)
+
+    @property
+    def tile_first0(self) -> int:
+        """Past one token tile: each slot's first pick tile, then their count."""
+        return self.queue0 + 1
+
+    @property
+    def tile_slot0(self) -> int:
+        """Past one token tile: each pick tile's slot of U."""
+        return self.tile_first0 + self.max_u + 1
+
+    @property
+    def queue0(self) -> int:
+        """The ug task this CTA took from the queue (``take_ug_task``)."""
+        return self.mask0 + MASK_WORDS * self.experts
+
+    @property
+    def expert_slot0(self) -> int:
+        """The route table's per-expert slots (a slot where the expert is in U)."""
+        return 3 * self.picks + 1 + self.max_u
+
+    @property
+    def order0(self) -> int:
+        """The picks (t topk + k) in slot order, a slot's ascending."""
+        return self.expert_slot0 + self.experts
+
+    @property
+    def first0(self) -> int:
+        """Each slot's first position in the pick order, then the pick count."""
+        return self.order0 + self.picks
+
+    @property
+    def mask0(self) -> int:
+        """Each expert's tokens that picked it, a bit a token (``MASK_WORDS``)."""
+        return self.first0 + self.max_u + 1
+
+    @property
+    def tile_picks(self) -> int:
+        """A slot's picks at most: a token picks an expert once."""
+        return min(self.tokens, 16)
+
+    def route_w(self, tab, s, t, k):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + (t * 2 * self.topk + self.topk + k)).bitcast(
+            fx.Float32
+        )
+
+    def n_union(self, tab, s):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + 2 * s * self.topk)
+
+    def union_expert(self, tab, s, u):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + (2 * s * self.topk + 1 + u))
+
+    def slot_first(self, tab, u):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + (self.first0 + u))
+
+    def pick_at(self, tab, i):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + (self.order0 + i))
+
+    def tile_first(self, tab, u):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + (self.tile_first0 + u))
+
+    def tile_slot(self, tab, i):
+        return fx.ptr_load(tab + (self.tile_slot0 + i))
+
+
+def route_shape(key: MoeBuild) -> RouteShape:
+    return RouteShape(key.experts, key.topk, key.tokens, key.tp, key.ug_groups)

+# Vendored from vllm-project/vllm @ 193922d6ff: vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/mono/stages/router.py

+"""V4.1's router GEMV tile for decode: bf16 x [T, 5120] times the gate weight
+[384, 5120] -> f32 logits, in one fixed summation order.
+
+Rows 16 a tile, K in ``PARTS`` contiguous parts, 16x16x32 bf16 MFMA: in part
+p wave w takes the part's K steps w, w + 8, ... (32 columns each) in that
+order, and the eight wave partials are summed in wave order
+(``common.ops.row_sum``); the MoE's route stage sums the parts in part
+order. The MoE stages spread a tile's parts over PARTS CTAs, and past 16 tokens
+a token tile a CTA too, which the order allows: a CTA alone cannot read a
+tile, or every token's x, fast enough.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.device.ops import WAVES, mfma_bf16, rsrc
+
+HIDDEN = 5120
+ROWS = 16  # a tile's rows: the MFMA's M
+PARTS = 4  # contiguous K parts of a tile, summed in order
+
+
+def _k0s(part, lane, wave):
+    """The K offsets of this lane's loads in part ``part`` (8 bf16 each)."""
+    per_wave = HIDDEN // 32 // WAVES // PARTS
+    assert per_wave * 32 * WAVES * PARTS == HIDDEN
+    return [
+        (part * per_wave * WAVES + wave + WAVES * i) * 32 + 8 * (lane // 16)
+        for i in range(per_wave)
+    ]
+
+
+def router_weight_loads(w, task, part, lane, wave, w_cm=0):
+    """``router_tile``'s weight operands (rows 16 task .., K part ``part``).
+    ``w_cm``: their load cache policy (nontemporal where nothing else of the
+    step reuses them)."""
+    row = task * ROWS + lane % 16
+    return [
+        fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(w),
+                (row * HIDDEN + k0) // 2,
+                vec_width=4,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+                cache_modifier=w_cm,
+            )
+        )
+        for k0 in _k0s(part, lane, wave)
+    ]
+
+
+def router_x_loads(x, part, s, lane, wave, x_cm=0, t0=0):
+    """``router_tile``'s x operands: the s tokens from ``t0`` (column
+    lane % 16; ``t0`` traced or an int). ``x_cm``: their load cache policy
+    (device scope when another CTA of the same launch wrote x)."""
+    tok = fx.min(lane % 16, s - 1)

+        tok = tok + t0

+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(x),
+                (tok * HIDDEN + k0) // 2,
+                vec_width=4,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+                cache_modifier=x_cm,
+            )
+        )
+        for k0 in _k0s(part, lane, wave)
+    ]
+
+
+def router_tile_mfma(wvs, xvs, lane, wave, red):
+    """``router_tile``'s MFMAs, K steps in order -> ``red[wave][lane]``."""
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    for i in range_constexpr(len(wvs)):
+        acc = mfma_bf16(wvs[i].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xvs[i].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), acc)
+    fx.ptr_store(acc, red + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4)

+"""The mono layer's mHC seam stages, each a task table of a persistent launch
+handing off through the tagged mailbox:
+
+    slice   (160, 32 hidden columns x 4 streams each): the owed post folded into
+            the residual (R_new, bf16 out), the collapsed layer input (mailbox
+            LIN) and the partial mix projection / sum of squares (mailbox PMIX)
+    gate    (S): the 160 partials -> post / comb (Sinkhorn) and the next pre
+    norm    (S): the RMSNorm -> the bf16 row, handed to the caller's store
+    reduce  (160): the FFN seam's attention output, the TP ranks' partials
+            (pushed to every rank's ATTN region) summed in the all-reduce's
+            order -> ``pend_lds``, where its slice reads it
+    push    (160): a rank's partial given in memory (an attention vLLM ran)
+            to every rank's ATTN region, ahead of the slice's reduce
+
+Every elementwise step follows aiter's ``mhc_fused_post_pre_delayed_rmsnorm``
+rounding; the mix projection and the sums of squares, split-K reductions,
+differ only in their split and order.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.device.ops import (
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+    batched_rounds,
+    bf16_round,
+    bf_hi,
+    bf_lo,
+    butterfly,
+    hw_exp2,
+    hw_rcp,
+    hw_rsq,
+    lane_gather,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.device.ranks import sum_partials
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.device.sync import preg
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.plan.layout import pair_layout
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.stages.gemv import (
+    ld_bf,
+    ld_f32,
+    plus,
+    token_tiles,
+)
+
+HC = 4
+HIDDEN = 5120
+K_MIX = HC * HIDDEN
+MIX = HC * (HC + 2)  # 24 projections: pre 4 | post 4 | comb 16
+EPS = 1e-20
+HC_EPS = 1e-6
+SINKHORN = 20
+POST_MULT = 2.0
+LOG2E = 1.0 / math.log(2.0)
+
+COLS = 32  # hidden columns a slice task
+SLICES = HIDDEN // COLS  # 160
+KT = HC * COLS  # projection columns a slice task
+PART = MIX + 1  # a slice's partials a token: the mixes, then the sum of squares
+GATE_BLOCK = 8  # slices a gate thread sums
+
+
+def scratch_layout(tokens: int) -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]:
+    """Mailbox region -> (byte offset, bytes) of a seam; 8 B a pair."""
+    pairs = {
+        "lin": tokens * HIDDEN // 2,  # bf16 pairs
+        "pmix": SLICES * tokens * PART,
+    }
+    return pair_layout(pairs.items())
+
+
+def attn_peer_bytes(tokens: int, tp: int) -> int:
+    """ATTN: ``[source rank][token][hidden / 2]`` bf16 pairs."""
+    return tp * tokens * HIDDEN // 2 * 8
+
+
+def attn_region_pair(src, t, s, col):
+    return (src * s + t) * (HIDDEN // 2) + col // 2
+
+
+def fma(a, b, c):
+    return fx.Float32(fmath.fma(a, b, c))
+
+
+def sigmoid(z):
+    """Triton's ``tl.sigmoid``: 1 / (1 + exp2(-z log2(e)))."""
+    return fx.Float32(1.0) / (fx.Float32(1.0) + hw_exp2(z * fx.Float32(-LOG2E)))
+
+
+def lane_f32(v, src):
+    return lane_gather(v.bitcast(fx.Int32), src).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def pend_value(c, t, col, cc):
+    """The owed post's sublayer output at (token t, column col): read from
+    ``pend``, or where a caller staged it (``pend_lds``, ``[token][32]`` of this
+    task's columns: a reduction it did first)."""
+    if const_expr(c.get("pend_lds") is None):
+        return ld_bf(c["args"]["pend"], t * HIDDEN + col)
+    return fx.ptr_load(c["pend_lds"] + (t * COLS + cc))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- slice
+@traced
+def slice_input(c, task, idx):
+    """Thread ``idx``'s pair of the layer input (token idx / 16, columns
+    32 task + 2 (idx % 16) ..)."""
+    s, rl = c["S"], c["rl"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    c0 = task * COLS
+    if idx < s * COLS // 2:
+        t = idx // (COLS // 2)
+        cc = 2 * (idx % (COLS // 2))
+        outs = []
+        for d in range_constexpr(2):
+            acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for h in range_constexpr(HC):
+                rb = fx.ptr_load(rl + (t * KT + h * COLS + cc + d))
+                acc = acc + ld_f32(a["pre_in"], t * HC + h) * rb
+            outs.append(acc)
+        c["put_bf"](c["lin"], t * HIDDEN + c0 + cc, outs)
+
+
+def slice_at(c0, e):
+    """Element e of a slice task at column c0: (token, stream, hidden column)."""
+    return e // KT, (e % KT) // COLS, c0 + e % COLS
+
+
+def slice_loads(c, c0, e):
+    """Element e's loads of ``stage_slice`` (e clamped into the step's)."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    t, o, col = slice_at(c0, e)
+    r = [ld_bf(a["res_in"], (t * HC + h) * HIDDEN + col) for h in range(HC)]
+    cm = [ld_f32(a["comb_in"], (t * HC + h) * HC + o) for h in range(HC)]
+    return r, cm, ld_f32(a["post_in"], t * HC + o)
+
+
+def slice_row(c, c0, e, got):
+    """Element e of ``stage_slice``'s R_new from ``slice_loads``' values."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    t, o, col = slice_at(c0, e)
+    r, cm, post = got
+    # aiter's mhc_fused_post_pre_delayed_rmsnorm: ((post x + c0 r0)
+    # + c1 r1) + c2 r2, each product rounded, then fma(c3, r3, ..)
+    v = post * pend_value(c, t, col, e % COLS) + (r[0] * cm[0])
+    for h in range_constexpr(1, HC - 1):
+        v = v + cm[h] * r[h]
+    # bf16 R_new is what the collapse, the sums of squares and the
+    # mix projection all read
+    v = bf16_round(fma(cm[HC - 1], r[HC - 1], v))
+    bo.buffer_store(v.to(fx.BFloat16), rsrc(a["res_out"]), (t * HC + o) * HIDDEN + col)
+    fx.ptr_store(v, c["rl"] + (t * KT + o * COLS + e % COLS))
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_slice(c, task):
+    """R_new, the layer input and the partial projections of hidden columns
+    32 task .. +32, all four streams, every token."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    rl, fl = c["rl"], c["fl"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    c0 = task * COLS
+    batched_rounds(
+        tid,
+        s * KT,
+        lambda e: slice_loads(c, c0, e),
+        lambda e, got: slice_row(c, c0, e, got),
+    )
+    for i in range_constexpr((MIX * KT + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        e = tid + THREADS * i
+        if e < MIX * KT:
+            j = e // KT
+            o = (e % KT) // COLS
+            # the original's two bf16 MFMAs take fn as hi = bf16(fn) and lo =
+            # bf16(fn - hi): their sum, exact in fp32, is the weight it applies
+            f = ld_f32(a["hc_fn"], j * K_MIX + o * HIDDEN + c0 + e % COLS)
+            hi = bf16_round(f)
+            fx.ptr_store(hi + bf16_round(f - hi), fl + e)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # the layer input: bf16 R_new of the four streams by the incoming pre-mix,
+    # products rounded, summed in order (the Triton collapse, no contraction);
+    # two columns a thread, one bf16 pair a mailbox store
+    for pas in range_constexpr(0, s * COLS // 2, THREADS):
+        slice_input(c, task, plus(pas, tid))
+    # sum of squares: token t on wave t % WAVES, two columns a lane
+    for t in range_constexpr(s):
+        if wave == t % WAVES:
+            x0 = fx.ptr_load(rl + (t * KT + 2 * lane))
+            x1 = fx.ptr_load(rl + (t * KT + 2 * lane + 1))
+            sq = butterfly(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+            if lane == 0:
+                c["put"](c["pmix"], (task * s + t) * PART + MIX, sq)
+    # mixes: fp32 MFMA 16x16x4, A = fn rows (two 16-row tiles), B = R_new^T,
+    # a token tile at a time
+    for t0, n in token_tiles(s):
+        slice_mix(c, task, t0, n)
+
+
+@traced
+def slice_mix(c, task, t0, n):
+    """The mix projection partials of tokens t0 .. t0 + n (``stage_slice``)."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    rl, fl, red = c["rl"], c["fl"], c["red"]
+    tok = plus(t0, fx.min(lane % 16, n - 1))
+    kw = KT // WAVES
+    cs = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(2)]
+    for kk in range_constexpr(kw // 4):
+        colk = wave * kw + lane // 16 + 4 * kk
+        b = fx.ptr_load(rl + (tok * KT + colk))
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            row = h * 16 + lane % 16
+            av = fx.ptr_load(fl + (fx.min(row, MIX - 1) * KT + colk))
+            av = (row < MIX).select(av, fx.Float32(0.0))
+            ops = rocdl._split_mfma_operands([av, b, cs[h], 0, 0, 0])
+            cs[h] = fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x4f32(T.vec(4, T.f32), *ops).result)
+    for h in range_constexpr(2):
+        fx.ptr_store(cs[h], red + ((wave * 2 + h) * 64 + lane) * 4)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if tid < MIX * n:
+        tl = tid // MIX
+        t = plus(t0, tl)
+        j = tid % MIX
+        h = j // 16
+        ln = 16 * ((j % 16) // 4) + tl
+        tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+            tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + (((w * 2 + h) * 64 + ln) * 4 + j % 4))
+        c["put"](c["pmix"], (task * s + t) * PART + j, tot)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gate
+def _row(v, lane, q):
+    """Comb lanes 8..23 hold ``comb[r][c]`` at lane 8 + 4 r + c: element q of
+    the row."""
+    return lane_f32(v, (lane - 8) // 4 * 4 + 8 + q)
+
+
+def _col(v, lane, q):
+    return lane_f32(v, 8 + 4 * q + (lane - 8) % 4)
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_gate(c, t):
+    """Token t's 160 slices, in slice order, -> post / comb / next pre."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    red = c["red"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    groups = SLICES // GATE_BLOCK  # 20
+    if tid < groups * PART:
+        g = tid // PART
+        j = tid % PART
+        vals = c["poll"](
+            [
+                (c["pmix"], ((g * GATE_BLOCK + k) * s + t) * PART + j, 1)
+                for k in range(GATE_BLOCK)
+            ]
+        )
+        acc = vals[0][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+        for k in range_constexpr(1, GATE_BLOCK):
+            acc = acc + vals[k][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+        fx.ptr_store(acc, red + (g * PART + j))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if wave == 0:
+        j = fx.min(lane, MIX - 1)
+        mix = fx.ptr_load(red + j)
+        sq = fx.ptr_load(red + MIX)
+        for g in range_constexpr(1, groups):
+            mix = mix + fx.ptr_load(red + (g * PART + j))
+            sq = sq + fx.ptr_load(red + (g * PART + MIX))
+        sc = [ld_f32(a["hc_scale"], i) for i in range(3)]
+        base = ld_f32(a["hc_base"], j)
+        # aiter's mhc_fused_post_pre_delayed_rmsnorm reduce: one rstd =
+        # rsq(fma(sum, 1/K, eps)), then each gate fma(mix rstd, scale, base)
+        v = mix * hw_rsq(fma(sq, fx.Float32(1.0 / K_MIX), fx.Float32(EPS)))
+        if lane < HC:
+            pre = sigmoid(fma(v, sc[0], base))
+            bo.buffer_store(pre + fx.Float32(HC_EPS), rsrc(a["pre_out"]), t * HC + lane)
+        if (lane >= HC) & (lane < 2 * HC):
+            post = sigmoid(fma(v, sc[1], base))
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                post * fx.Float32(POST_MULT), rsrc(a["post_out"]), t * HC + lane - HC
+            )
+        cv = fma(v, sc[2], base)
+        row = [_row(cv, lane, q) for q in range(4)]
+        # Triton's exp: exp2 of (x - max) log2(e)
+        m = fx.max(fx.max(row[0], row[1]), fx.max(row[2], row[3]))
+        cv = hw_exp2((cv - m) * fx.Float32(LOG2E))
+        # fast_dividef is x rcp(y); its first "+ eps" contracts into the fma
+        row = [_row(cv, lane, q) for q in range(4)]
+        cv = fma(cv, hw_rcp((row[0] + row[1]) + (row[2] + row[3])), fx.Float32(HC_EPS))
+        col = [_col(cv, lane, q) for q in range(4)]
+        cv = cv * hw_rcp(((col[0] + col[1]) + (col[2] + col[3])) + fx.Float32(HC_EPS))
+        for _ in range_constexpr(SINKHORN - 1):
+            row = [_row(cv, lane, q) for q in range(4)]
+            cv = cv * hw_rcp(
+                ((row[0] + row[1]) + (row[2] + row[3])) + fx.Float32(HC_EPS)
+            )
+            col = [_col(cv, lane, q) for q in range(4)]
+            cv = cv * hw_rcp(
+                ((col[0] + col[1]) + (col[2] + col[3])) + fx.Float32(HC_EPS)
+            )
+        if (lane >= 2 * HC) & (lane < MIX):
+            bo.buffer_store(cv, rsrc(a["comb_out"]), t * HC * HC + lane - 2 * HC)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- norm
+@traced
+def stage_norm(c, t, store):
+    """Token t's RMSNorm (rstd = rsq(fma(sum, 1/H, eps)), bf16((x rstd) w));
+    256 threads, 3 chunks of 8 at 8 t + 2048 c, each chunk's bf16 values handed
+    to ``store(t, col, ys, live)`` by every thread (``live``: a thread's chunk
+    in the row; threads 256.. mirror thread 255)."""
+    tid, lane, wave, red = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    tt = fx.min(tid, 255)
+    mine = tid < 256
+    cols = [tt * 8 + 2048 * ch for ch in range(3)]
+    xs = []
+    for ch in range_constexpr(3):
+        base = t * HIDDEN + fx.min(cols[ch], HIDDEN - 8)
+        words = c["poll"]([(c["lin"], base // 2 + k, 1) for k in range(4)])
+        v = []
+        for k in range_constexpr(4):
+            v += [bf_lo(words[k][0]), bf_hi(words[k][0])]
+        xs.append([(cols[ch] < HIDDEN).select(x, fx.Float32(0.0)) for x in v])
+    acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for ch in range_constexpr(3):
+        for x in xs[ch]:
+            acc = acc + x * x
+    acc = butterfly(acc, (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32))
+    if (lane == 0) & mine:
+        fx.ptr_store(acc, red + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    tot = butterfly(fx.ptr_load(red + lane % 4), (1, 2))
+    r = hw_rsq(fma(tot, fx.Float32(1.0 / HIDDEN), fx.Float32(EPS)))
+    for ch in range_constexpr(3):
+        col = fx.min(cols[ch], HIDDEN - 8)
+        ys = [
+            bf16_round((xs[ch][j] * r) * ld_bf(a["norm_w"], col + j)) for j in range(8)
+        ]
+        store(t, col, ys, mine & (cols[ch] < HIDDEN))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- reduce
+@traced
+def stage_reduce(c, task):
+    """The attention output at this slice's 32 columns: the TP ranks' partials
+    in the all-reduce's order (``sum_partials``), in fp32 -> bf16 ->
+    ``pend_lds``."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    for pas in range_constexpr(0, s * COLS // 2, THREADS):
+        reduce_attn_pair(c, task, plus(pas, tid))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def reduce_attn_pair(c, task, idx):
+    """Thread ``idx``'s column pair of token idx / 16 (``stage_reduce``)."""
+    s = c["S"]
+    c0 = task * COLS
+    if idx < s * COLS // 2:
+        t = idx // (COLS // 2)
+        col = c0 + 2 * (idx % (COLS // 2))
+        own = preg(c["sym"], 0, "attn")
+        acc0, acc1 = sum_partials(
+            c["poll"],
+            own,
+            lambda src: attn_region_pair(src, t, s, col),
+            c["d"].tp,
+        )
+        lds = c["pend_lds"] + (t * COLS + col - c0)
+        fx.ptr_store(bf16_round(acc0), lds)
+        fx.ptr_store(bf16_round(acc1), lds + 1)
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_push(c, task, part):
+    """This rank's attention partial (``part``: bf16 [S, HIDDEN], wo_b's
+    unreduced output) at this slice's 32 columns, every token, to every rank's
+    ATTN region: the pairs ``stage_reduce`` polls, as the bits vLLM wrote."""
+    s, tid, tp = c["S"], c["tid"], c["d"].tp
+    for pas in range_constexpr(0, s * COLS // 2, THREADS):
+        idx = plus(pas, tid)
+        if idx < s * COLS // 2:
+            t = idx // (COLS // 2)
+            col = task * COLS + 2 * (idx % (COLS // 2))
+            w = bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(part), (t * HIDDEN + col) // 2, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32
+            )
+            pair = attn_region_pair(c["rank"], t, s, col)
+            for p in range_constexpr(tp):
+                c["put_words"](preg(c["peer_addr"](p), 0, "attn"), pair, [w])

+"""Enabling and refusal (RFC #43949 section 6): default-deny over deployment features, the spec's requirements, then
+its own checks, every reason reported at once. Config-stage refusals run from the server-args pipeline
+(``handle_monokernel``); model-stage ones in ``runtime.attach``."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Any, Callable, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.spec import DeviceLimits, Feature, MonoSpec, load_spec
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# the SGLang names this module reads (pinned by test_mono_contract)
+SGLANG_READS = (
+    "sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base.model_config_of",
+    "sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides.resolving_view",
+)
+
+SWITCH = "--enable-monokernel"
+
+
+class MonoRefused(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+def mono_enabled(cfg: Any) -> bool:
+    """``--enable-monokernel`` on the (resolved) server args."""
+    return bool(getattr(cfg, "enable_monokernel", False))
+
+
+class _Unreadable(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _read(cfg: Any, name: str):
+    try:
+        return getattr(cfg, name)
+    except AttributeError:
+        raise _Unreadable(name) from None
+
+
+def _verify_uneven(c) -> bool:
+    if _read(c, "speculative_algorithm") is None:
+        return False
+    return (_read(c, "speculative_eagle_topk") or 1) > 1
+
+
+# feature -> "in use" on the resolved server args; a setting it cannot read counts as in use
+_FEATURE_IN_USE: dict[Feature, Callable[[Any], bool]] = {
+    Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL: lambda c: (_read(c, "pp_size") or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.MULTI_NODE_TP: lambda c: (_read(c, "nnodes") or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.DP_ATTENTION: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_dp_attention")),
+    Feature.EXPERT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (_read(c, "ep_size") or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.EPLB: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_eplb")),
+    Feature.CONTEXT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (
+        (_read(c, "attn_cp_size") or 1) > 1 or (_read(c, "dcp_size") or 1) > 1
+    ),
+    Feature.SPEC_VERIFY: lambda c: _read(c, "speculative_algorithm") is not None,
+    Feature.UNEVEN_VERIFY: _verify_uneven,
+    Feature.TWO_BATCH_OVERLAP: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_two_batch_overlap")),
+    Feature.LORA: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_lora")),
+    Feature.PD_DISAGGREGATION: lambda c: (
+        _read(c, "disaggregation_mode") not in (None, "null")
+    ),
+    Feature.ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE: lambda c: bool(
+        _read(c, "enable_return_routed_experts")
+    ),
+    Feature.INDEXER_TOPK_CAPTURE: lambda c: bool(
+        _read(c, "enable_return_indexer_topk")
+    ),
+    Feature.EAGLE3_HIDDEN_STATES: lambda c: (
+        str(_read(c, "speculative_algorithm")).upper() == "EAGLE3"
+    ),
+    Feature.KV_OFFLOAD: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_hierarchical_cache")),
+    Feature.MEMORY_RELEASE: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_memory_saver")),
+    Feature.CPU_OFFLOAD: lambda c: (_read(c, "cpu_offload_gb") or 0) > 0,
+    Feature.TORCH_COMPILE: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_torch_compile")),
+    Feature.DETERMINISTIC: lambda c: bool(_read(c, "enable_deterministic_inference")),
+    Feature.EAGER: lambda c: bool(
+        _read(c, "disable_cuda_graph") or _read(c, "disable_decode_cuda_graph")
+    ),
+}
+
+# Requirements field -> the server setting it constrains
+_REQUIRED_SETTING = {
+    "dtypes": "dtype",
+    "kv_cache": "kv_cache_dtype",
+    "attention_backends": "attention_backend",
+    "moe_backends": "moe_runner_backend",
+}
+
+
+def current_isa() -> Optional[str]:
+    """The GPU's ISA (e.g. ``gfx950``), or None without a ROCm GPU."""
+    if not torch.version.hip or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return None
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName.split(":")[0]
+
+
+def device_limits(spec: MonoSpec, isa: Optional[str]) -> Optional[DeviceLimits]:
+    return spec.devices.get(isa) if isa is not None else None
+
+
+def _in_use(feature: Feature, cfg: Any) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    try:
+        return _FEATURE_IN_USE[feature](cfg), ""
+    except _Unreadable as e:
+        return True, f" (cannot read {e.args[0]})"
+
+
+def feature_refusals(cfg: Any, spec: MonoSpec) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for feature in _FEATURE_IN_USE:
+        if feature in spec.features or feature is Feature.EAGER:
+            continue  # eager is allowed, with a warning (debugging only)
+        used, why = _in_use(feature, cfg)
+        if used:
+            reasons.append(
+                f"{feature.value}{why} is not supported by the {spec.name} monokernels"
+            )
+    return reasons
+
+
+def requirement_refusals(cfg: Any, spec: MonoSpec) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for field_name, setting in _REQUIRED_SETTING.items():
+        accepted = getattr(spec.requires, field_name)
+        if not accepted:
+            continue
+        try:
+            value = _read(cfg, setting)
+        except _Unreadable:
+            reasons.append(
+                f"cannot read {setting}; the {spec.name} monokernels need one of {sorted(accepted)}"
+            )
+            continue
+        if str(value) not in accepted:
+            reasons.append(
+                f"{setting}={value!r}: the {spec.name} monokernels need one of {sorted(accepted)}"
+            )
+    return reasons
+
+
+def common_refusals(cfg: Any, spec: MonoSpec, isa: Optional[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Reasons every monokernel model shares: unlisted features in use, requirements, the wait deadline, TP
+    size, ISA."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.common_hip.guard import deadline_refusals
+
+    reasons = feature_refusals(cfg, spec) + requirement_refusals(cfg, spec)
+    reasons += deadline_refusals(getattr(cfg, "watchdog_timeout", None))
+    limits = device_limits(spec, isa)
+    if limits is None:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"the {spec.name} monokernels are built for {', '.join(spec.devices)}, not {isa or 'this GPU'}"
+        )
+    tp = getattr(cfg, "tp_size", None) or 1
+    tp_sizes = (
+        limits.tp_sizes
+        if limits is not None
+        else tuple(sorted({t for d in spec.devices.values() for t in d.tp_sizes}))
+    )
+    if tp not in tp_sizes:
+        reasons.append(
+            f"tp_size {tp} not in {spec.name}'s supported TP sizes {tp_sizes}"
+        )
+    return reasons
+
+
+def config_refusals(
+    cfg: Any, hf_config: Any, spec: MonoSpec, isa: Optional[str]
+) -> list[str]:
+    return common_refusals(cfg, spec, isa) + list(
+        spec.config_disable_reasons(cfg, hf_config)
+    )
+
+
+def device_refusals(spec: MonoSpec, limits: DeviceLimits) -> list[str]:
+    """The launch grid must fit the CUs present (a partitioned GPU has fewer)."""
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return []
+    cus = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+        torch.cuda.current_device()
+    ).multi_processor_count
+    if cus < limits.resident_blocks:
+        return [
+            f"{cus} CUs present, the {spec.name} monokernels keep {limits.resident_blocks} workgroups resident"
+            " (partitioned GPU?)"
+        ]
+    return []
+
+
+def raise_if_refused(stage: str, spec_name: str, reasons: list[str]) -> None:
+    if reasons:
+        lines = "\n  - ".join(reasons)
+        raise MonoRefused(f"{SWITCH} refused ({spec_name}, {stage}):\n  - {lines}")
+
+
+def warn_eager(cfg: Any, spec: MonoSpec) -> None:
+    used, _ = _in_use(Feature.EAGER, cfg)
+    if used and Feature.EAGER not in spec.features:
+        logger.warning(
+            "monokernels under eager decode: debugging only (graphs disabled)"
+        )
+
+
+def handle_monokernel(server_args) -> None:
+    """The config hook: refuse at startup (every reason at once) when the model has no spec or the resolved
+    deployment uses a feature the spec does not support. Runs after every other resolution."""
+    from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import model_config_of
+    from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolving_view
+
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if not mono_enabled(cfg):
+        return
+    hf_config = model_config_of(server_args).hf_config
+    arch = (hf_config.architectures or ["?"])[0]
+    spec = load_spec(arch)
+    if spec is None:
+        raise MonoRefused(f"{SWITCH}: no mono spec for {arch}")
+    raise_if_refused(
+        "config", spec.name, config_refusals(cfg, hf_config, spec, current_isa())
+    )
+    warn_eager(cfg, spec)
+    logger.info("%s: %s mono spec accepted the configuration", SWITCH, spec.name)

+"""The monokernel runtime (RFC #43949 sections 2 and 5): the calls SGLang makes in each process, with the switch off
+each a no-op.
+
+  load_weights(), each tensor         tensor = load_tensor(model, name, tensor); loaded(model) at the end
+  precompile_kernels_after_loading()  attach(loop_module, architecture)
+  the layer loop                      plan = route(loop_module, forward_batch) once a forward;
+                                      span = kernel(plan, i, "layer_in") at each span start (None: the normal layer)
+
+A step not routed to the kernels runs the model's layers exactly as before; the module tree, parameter names and weight
+loading are untouched by the switch. Routing is a function of what every rank sees alike (forward mode, row count,
+batch size), so under CUDA graphs the decision baked in at capture is what every replay repeats.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import logging
+import time
+from collections import Counter
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Callable, NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono import check, guards
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.spec import (
+    Feature,
+    LayerKernel,
+    MonoContext,
+    MonoModel,
+    MonoSpec,
+    MonoStep,
+    Point,
+    Span,
+    check_spans,
+    load_spec,
+    span_label,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# the SGLang names this module reads (pinned by test_mono_contract)
+SGLANG_READS = (
+    "sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config.Backend",
+    "sglang.srt.runtime_context.get_exec",
+    "sglang.srt.runtime_context.get_parallel",
+    "sglang.srt.runtime_context.get_server_args",
+)
+
+_RUNTIME = "_mono_runtime"  # attribute of the layer-loop module that holds its runtime
+
+
+class MonoUnsupported(Exception):
+    """The loaded model or runtime configuration is outside what the kernels serve."""
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """True when every rank of ``group`` (a CPU / gloo group, or None for one rank) passed ``ok`` true. A kernel waits
+    in-kernel on every peer, so a rank that turned monokernels off alone, or failed to build what the others launch,
+    must take every other rank with it; every rank calls this at the same point."""
+    if group is None:
+        return ok
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def _server_args():
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_server_args
+
+    return get_server_args()
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _spec(architecture: str) -> Optional[MonoSpec]:
+    return load_spec(architecture)
+
+
+# ---- routing ----
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Decision:
+    step: Optional[MonoStep]  # None: the model's own path
+    reason: str  # why not, for metrics ("" when routed)
+
+
+def decide(
+    spec: MonoSpec,
+    ctx: MonoContext,
+    *,
+    is_decode: bool,
+    is_verify: bool,
+    rows: int,
+    batch_size: int,
+) -> Decision:
+    if not (is_decode or is_verify):
+        return Decision(None, "not decode")
+    if is_verify and Feature.SPEC_VERIFY not in spec.features:
+        return Decision(None, "verify unsupported")
+    if rows not in ctx.limits.widths:
+        return Decision(None, "width")
+    if batch_size < 1 or rows % batch_size:
+        return Decision(None, "rows not a multiple of the batch")
+    step = MonoStep(
+        rows=rows,
+        batch_size=batch_size,
+        is_verify=is_verify,
+        query_len=rows // batch_size,
+    )
+    why = spec.eligible(ctx, step)
+    if why:
+        return Decision(None, why)
+    return Decision(step, "")
+
+
+def decide_for_batch(spec: MonoSpec, ctx: MonoContext, forward_batch) -> Decision:
+    mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+    rows = (
+        int(forward_batch.input_ids.shape[0])
+        if forward_batch.input_ids is not None
+        else 0
+    )
+    return decide(
+        spec,
+        ctx,
+        is_decode=mode.is_decode(),
+        is_verify=mode.is_target_verify(),
+        rows=rows,
+        batch_size=int(forward_batch.batch_size),
+    )
+
+
+# ---- the runtime a model holds ----
+
+
+class Route(NamedTuple):
+    spans: tuple[Span, ...]
+    kernel: LayerKernel
+    step: MonoStep
+    cache: dict  # per-step memo the spec's glue may fill once and share across the step's layers
+    checker: Optional[check.Checker] = (
+        None  # set on the steps check mode compares against the module path
+    )
+
+
+class MonoRuntime:
+    def __init__(self, spec: MonoSpec, ctx: MonoContext, model: MonoModel) -> None:
+        self.spec, self.ctx, self.model = spec, ctx, model
+        self.spans = dict(model.spans)
+        check_spans(self.spans)
+        self._kernels: dict[int, LayerKernel] = {}
+        self.decision = Decision(None, "no step yet")
+        self.step_cache: dict = {}
+        self.counts: Counter = Counter()
+        self.state = dict(spec.state_bindings(ctx, model))
+        self.checker = check.Checker(ctx.tp_rank) if check.requested() else None
+        self._checking = False
+        logger.info(
+            "mono kernels on: spec=%s widths=%s layers=%d (%s)",
+            spec.name,
+            list(ctx.limits.widths),
+            len(self.spans),
+            dict(Counter(span_label(s) for s in self.spans.values())),
+        )
+
+    def begin_step(self, forward_batch) -> Decision:
+        self.step_cache = {}
+        d = decide_for_batch(self.spec, self.ctx, forward_batch)
+        if d.step is not None and d.step.rows not in self._kernels:
+            d = Decision(None, "width not built")
+        self.decision = d
+        self._checking = (
+            d.step is not None
+            and self.checker is not None
+            and self.checker.begin_step()
+        )
+        self.counts["mono" if d.step is not None else f"fallback:{d.reason}"] += 1
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing() and self.ctx.tp_rank == 0:
+            # replays never reach Python: the capture is where a graph's path is decided
+            logger.info(
+                "mono graph capture: %d rows -> %s",
+                int(forward_batch.input_ids.shape[0]),
+                "mono" if d.step is not None else f"model path ({d.reason})",
+            )
+        return d
+
+    def routed(self, layer_id: int) -> Optional[Route]:
+        """The route when this step runs layer ``layer_id`` on the kernels, else None."""
+        step = self.decision.step
+        if step is None:
+            return None
+        spans = self.spans.get(layer_id)
+        if spans is None:
+            return None
+        binding = self.state.get(layer_id)
+        if binding is not None:
+            binding.wait_ready()
+        return Route(
+            spans,
+            self._kernels[step.rows],
+            step,
+            self.step_cache,
+            self.checker if self._checking else None,
+        )
+
+    def build_widths(self, widths) -> dict[int, int]:
+        """Build every width now, collectively (bytes of scratch each allocated); any rank failing refuses mono."""
+        scratch = {}
+        for rows in widths:
+            before = torch.cuda.memory_allocated() if torch.cuda.is_available() else 0
+            kernel = None
+            try:
+                kernel = self.model.kernel(rows)
+            except Exception:
+                logger.exception(
+                    "mono %s: building the %d-row kernels failed", self.spec.name, rows
+                )
+            if not tp_agree(kernel is not None, self.ctx.cpu_group):
+                guards.raise_if_refused(
+                    "model",
+                    self.spec.name,
+                    [f"building the {rows}-row kernels failed on a TP rank"],
+                )
+            self._kernels[rows] = kernel
+            if torch.cuda.is_available():
+                scratch[rows] = torch.cuda.memory_allocated() - before
+        return scratch
+
+
+def attach_spec(
+    model,
+    spec: MonoSpec,
+    *,
+    server_args,
+    hf_config,
+    tp_rank: int,
+    tp_size: int,
+    cpu_group,
+    device,
+) -> MonoRuntime:
+    """The runtime of ``spec`` on ``model``, its widths not built yet."""
+    guards.raise_if_refused("model", spec.name, list(spec.model_disable_reasons(model)))
+    isa = guards.current_isa()
+    limits = guards.device_limits(spec, isa)
+    if limits is None:
+        guards.raise_if_refused(
+            "model", spec.name, [f"no {spec.name} mono kernels for {isa or 'this GPU'}"]
+        )
+    ctx = MonoContext(
+        server_args=server_args,
+        hf_config=hf_config,
+        tp_size=tp_size,
+        tp_rank=tp_rank,
+        cpu_group=cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device(device),
+        limits=limits,
+    )
+    return MonoRuntime(spec, ctx, spec.build(model, ctx))
+
+
+# ---- weight loading ----
+
+
+def load_tensor(model, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Each checkpoint tensor, before renames and quantization; returns it unchanged."""
+    if not guards.mono_enabled(_server_args()):
+        return tensor
+    spec = _spec(type(model).__name__)
+    if spec is not None and spec.load_tensor is not None:
+        spec.load_tensor(model, name, tensor)
+    return tensor
+
+
+def loaded(model) -> None:
+    """The end of ``load_weights()``."""
+
+
+# ---- after loading, before KV sizing ----
+
+
+def _step_widths(
+    spec_rows: tuple[int, ...], widths: tuple[int, ...]
+) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """The widths steps can reach: each decode capture size times each step's rows a request; every width without
+    decode graphs (eager, debugging only)."""
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import Backend
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
+
+    cg = get_exec().graph.cuda_graph_config
+    if cg is None or cg.decode.backend == Backend.DISABLED:
+        return tuple(widths)
+    return tuple(
+        sorted({bs * q for bs in cg.decode.bs for q in spec_rows} & set(widths))
+    )
+
+
+def attach(model, architecture: str) -> None:
+    """Attach the runtime of ``architecture``'s spec to ``model`` (the module whose forward runs the layer loop):
+    check the weights (all ranks refuse together), build every width a graph capture reaches, and compare the ranks'
+    plans. Raises ``MonoRefused`` with every reason."""
+    if not guards.mono_enabled(_server_args()):
+        return
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    spec = _spec(architecture)
+    if spec is None:
+        raise guards.MonoRefused(f"{guards.SWITCH}: no mono spec for {architecture}")
+    tp = get_parallel().tp_group
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    rt = attach_spec(
+        model,
+        spec,
+        server_args=_server_args(),
+        hf_config=model.config,
+        tp_rank=tp.rank_in_group,
+        tp_size=tp.world_size,
+        cpu_group=tp.cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device()),
+    )
+    guards.raise_if_refused(
+        "model", spec.name, guards.device_refusals(spec, rt.ctx.limits)
+    )
+    widths = _step_widths(rt.model.rows_per_request, rt.ctx.limits.widths)
+    scratch = rt.build_widths(widths)
+    _compare_plans(rt, widths)
+    setattr(model, _RUNTIME, rt)
+    _SKIP_METADATA.append(spec.skip_metadata)
+    # the weight updater refuses online updates on this (the kernels hold views and copies of the loaded weights)
+    model._derived_weight_cache_error = (
+        f"Online weight updates are not supported with {guards.SWITCH}: the {spec.name} monokernels "
+        "hold views and copies of the loaded weights."
+    )
+    if rt.ctx.tp_rank == 0:
+        logger.info(
+            "mono %s: attached in %.1f s; built widths %s; scratch MiB per width %s",
+            spec.name,
+            time.perf_counter() - t0,
+            list(widths),
+            {w: round(b / 2**20, 1) for w, b in scratch.items()},
+        )
+
+
+def _compare_plans(rt: MonoRuntime, widths: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+    """Every rank routes the same layers at the same widths, or none starts."""
+    plan = (
+        rt.spec.name,
+        tuple(
+            sorted((i, tuple(s.name for s in spans)) for i, spans in rt.spans.items())
+        ),
+        widths,
+    )
+    group = rt.ctx.cpu_group
+    if group is None:
+        return
+    plans = [None] * dist.get_world_size(group)
+    dist.all_gather_object(plans, plan, group=group)
+    if any(p != plan for p in plans):
+        raise guards.MonoRefused(
+            f"{guards.SWITCH} refused ({rt.spec.name}): the TP ranks' plans differ"
+        )
+
+
+# ---- the layer loop ----
+
+
+class Plan(NamedTuple):
+    runtime: MonoRuntime
+
+
+_SKIP_METADATA: list = []  # each attached spec's skip_metadata
+
+
+def skip_metadata(name: str, forward_batch, key, source) -> bool:
+    """True when the attached kernels never read SGLang's per-step metadata ``name`` (``key``, built from
+    ``source``) this step, so the backend need not build it. False with the switch off."""
+    return any(f(name, forward_batch, key, source) for f in _SKIP_METADATA)
+
+
+def route(model, forward_batch) -> Optional[Plan]:
+    """Once a forward: the step's plan, or None for the normal path (also with the switch off)."""
+    rt: Optional[MonoRuntime] = getattr(model, _RUNTIME, None)
+    if rt is None:
+        return None
+    if rt.begin_step(forward_batch).step is None:
+        return None
+    return Plan(rt)
+
+
+def kernel(
+    plan: Optional[Plan], layer_id: int, point: str
+) -> Optional[Callable[..., Any]]:
+    """At each span start: the span that runs layer ``layer_id`` from ``point``, or None for the normal path. The
+    span takes and returns exactly what the code it replaces does."""
+    if plan is None:
+        return None
+    route_ = plan.runtime.routed(layer_id)
+    if route_ is None or route_.spans[0].start is not Point[point.upper()]:
+        return None
+    return plan.runtime.model.span(route_)

+"""The contract between the mono runtime and a model's mono kernels (RFC #43949 section 3).
+
+A model opts in with one ``MonoSpec`` per vendor (registered at the end of this module); the runtime owns enabling, refusal, per-step
+routing, peer memory and fail-stop, and never interprets a layer's state: a span takes and returns exactly what the
+model's own layer code does between its two points, so covered and normal layers can alternate within a step.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import enum
+import importlib
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, Optional, Protocol
+
+import torch
+
+
+class Feature(enum.Enum):
+    """Deployment features refused by default (RFC #43949 section 6): one in use that the spec does not list is
+    refused, and a probe that cannot read its setting counts as in use."""
+
+    PIPELINE_PARALLEL = "pipeline parallelism"
+    MULTI_NODE_TP = "multi-node tensor parallelism"
+    DP_ATTENTION = "data-parallel attention"
+    EXPERT_PARALLEL = "expert parallelism"
+    EPLB = "expert load balancing"
+    CONTEXT_PARALLEL = "context parallelism"
+    SPEC_VERIFY = "speculative decoding"
+    UNEVEN_VERIFY = "uneven verify lengths (tree speculation)"
+    SPEC_DRAFT_LAYERS = "kernels on the speculative draft model's layers"
+    TWO_BATCH_OVERLAP = "two-batch overlap"
+    LORA = "LoRA adapters"
+    PD_DISAGGREGATION = "prefill/decode disaggregation"
+    ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE = "routed-expert capture"
+    INDEXER_TOPK_CAPTURE = "indexer top-k capture"
+    EAGLE3_HIDDEN_STATES = "EAGLE3 hidden states at covered layers"
+    KV_OFFLOAD = "KV offload (hierarchical cache)"
+    MEMORY_RELEASE = "memory release (memory saver)"
+    CPU_OFFLOAD = "CPU weight offload"
+    TORCH_COMPILE = "torch-compiled decode"
+    DETERMINISTIC = "deterministic inference"
+    EAGER = "eager decode steps (no CUDA graph)"
+
+
+class Point(enum.IntEnum):
+    """Where a span starts or ends, in layer order. ``LAYER_IN`` / ``LAYER_OUT`` carry whatever the layer loop passes
+    between layers (for example work still owed to the next layer)."""
+
+    LAYER_IN = 0
+    ATTN_IN = 1
+    CORE_IN = 2
+    CORE_OUT = 3
+    ATTN_PARTIAL = 4
+    MLP_IN = 5
+    MLP_PARTIAL = 6
+    LAYER_OUT = 7
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True)

+def _walk_case(rng, n):
+    """A step's rows: requests of ``per`` rows (1 decode, 6 verify, or ragged runs) with bounds around a context."""
+    kind = rng.integers(3)
+    sizes = []
+    while sum(sizes) < n:
+        sizes.append(1 if kind == 0 else 6 if kind == 1 else int(rng.integers(1, 9)))
+    owners, bounds, row = [], [], 0
+    for size in sizes:
+        size = min(size, n - row)
+        ctx = int(
+            rng.choice(
+                [
+                    0,
+                    300,
+                    512,
+                    513,
+                    int(rng.integers(0, 4096)),
+                    int(rng.integers(0, 1 << 20)),
+                ]
+            )
+        )
+        owners += [row] * size
+        bounds += [max(ctx - (size - 1 - r), 0) for r in range(size)]
+        row += size
+    return np.array(bounds, dtype=np.int32), np.array(owners, dtype=np.int32)
+
+

+    dev = torch.device("cuda")

+        plan.fill_(-7)
+        fill_walk_plan_device(
+            torch.from_numpy(bounds).to(dev), torch.from_numpy(owners).to(dev), plan, n
+        )
+        got = plan.cpu().numpy()
+        assert np.array_equal(got, want), (
+            n,
+            bounds.tolist(),
+            owners.tolist(),

+E2M1 = [
+    0.0,
+    0.5,
+    1.0,
+    1.5,
+    2.0,
+    3.0,
+    4.0,
+    6.0,
+    -0.0,
+    -0.5,
+    -1.0,
+    -1.5,
+    -2.0,
+    -3.0,
+    -4.0,
+    -6.0,
+]
+
+
+def _cdiv(a, b):
+    return -(-a // b)
+
+
+def fp4_case(ctxs, seed, per_req=6, dev="cuda"):
+    """Synthetic indexer inputs in SGLang's layouts: ``len(ctxs)`` requests of ``per_req`` rows, request r seeing
+    ``ctxs[r]`` compressed rows on its last row (one fewer each row before)."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(seed)
+    rows = len(ctxs) * per_req
+    ppr = _cdiv(max(ctxs), 64)
+    pages = len(ctxs) * ppr + 3
+    payload = torch.randint(
+        0, 256, (pages, 1, 4, 64, 16), generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    kscale = torch.randint(
+        123, 130, (pages, 1, 4, 64), generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    perm = torch.randperm(pages, generator=g, device=dev).to(torch.int32)
+    table = (
+        perm[: len(ctxs) * ppr]
+        .view(len(ctxs), ppr)
+        .repeat_interleave(per_req, 0)
+        .contiguous()
+    )
+    q = torch.randint(
+        0, 256, (rows, 32, 64), generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    qscale = torch.randint(
+        123, 130, (rows, 1, 4, 16, 4), generator=g, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    w = (torch.randn(rows, 32, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.05).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    bounds = torch.tensor(
+        [max(c - (per_req - 1 - i), 0) for c in ctxs for i in range(per_req)],
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device=dev,
+    )
+    return dict(q=q, qscale=qscale, w=w, payload=payload, kscale=kscale, table=table, bounds=bounds,
+                per_req=per_req)  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def _unpack(b):
+    lut = torch.tensor(E2M1, dtype=torch.float64, device=b.device)
+    return torch.stack([lut[(b & 15).long()], lut[(b >> 4).long()]], -1).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def ref_logits(case, t, cols):
+    """fp64 logits of row t at columns ``cols``: sum_h w_h relu(sum_c 2^qe 2^ke q.k)."""
+    page = case["table"][t][cols // 64].long()
+    slot = cols % 64
+    k = _unpack(case["payload"][page, 0, :, slot, :])  # [n, 4, 32]
+    ke = case["kscale"][
+        page[:, None],
+        0,
+        torch.arange(4, device=cols.device)[None],
+        ((slot % 16) * 4 + slot // 16)[:, None],
+    ]
+    ks = torch.exp2(ke.double() - 127)  # [n, 4]
+    q = _unpack(case["q"][t].view(32, 4, 16))  # [32, 4, 32]
+    h = torch.arange(32, device=cols.device)
+    qs = torch.exp2(
+        case["qscale"][t, 0][:, h % 16, h // 16].double().T - 127
+    )  # [32, 4]
+    s = torch.einsum("hcd,ncd->hnc", q, k) * qs[:, None, :] * ks[None]
+    return (case["w"][t].double()[:, None] * s.sum(-1).clamp_min(0)).sum(0)
+
+
+def run_k2i(runner, case, kind="full"):
+    rows = case["q"].shape[0]
+    owners, kmeta = runner.owners(rows, case["per_req"], case["table"].stride(0))
+    plan = runner.plan(1, case["bounds"], owners, rows)
+    raw = torch.full((rows, 512), -9, dtype=torch.int32, device=case["q"].device)
+    page = torch.full_like(raw, -9)
+    runner.launch(q_fp4=case["q"], q_scale=case["qscale"], weights=case["w"], k_payload=case["payload"],
+                  k_scale=case["kscale"], page_table=case["table"], bounds=case["bounds"], plan=plan, owners=owners,
+                  kmeta=kmeta, raw_out=raw, page_out=page, kind=kind)  # fmt: skip
+    runner.epoch[0] += 1
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    return raw, page
+
+
+def sglang_logits(case):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.fp4_indexer_hip import (
+        aiter_fp4_paged_mqa_logits,
+    )
+
+    return aiter_fp4_paged_mqa_logits(
+        q_fp4=case["q"], q_scale=case["qscale"], k_payload=case["payload"], k_scale=case["kscale"],
+        weights=case["w"], page_table=case["table"], c4_seq_lens=case["bounds"], weight_scale=1.0,
+        page_table_bucket=64, is_decode=True,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def check_selection(case, logits, raw, page):
+    """The selection is exact: every row's 512 best (or every column, in order, when it sees <= 512), ascending, -1
+    padded; its pool rows through the page table."""
+    for t in range(raw.shape[0]):
+        b = int(case["bounds"][t])
+        got = raw[t]
+        n = min(b, 512)
+        assert (got[n:] == -1).all() and (page[t][n:] == -1).all(), t
+        ids = got[:n].long()
+        assert (ids.diff() > 0).all() and ids.min() >= 0 and ids.max() < b, t
+        if b > 512:
+            row = logits[t, :b]
+            chosen = torch.zeros(b, dtype=torch.bool, device=row.device)
+            chosen[ids] = True
+            assert row[chosen].min() >= row[~chosen].max(), (
+                t,
+                float(row[chosen].min()),
+                float(row[~chosen].max()),
+            )
+        want_page = case["table"][t][ids // 64].long() * 64 + ids % 64
+        assert torch.equal(page[t][:n].long(), want_page), t
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+)
+def test_k2i_logits_and_selection(ctxs):
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.indexer.runner import (
+        K2iRunner,
+    )
+
+    case = fp4_case(ctxs, seed=len(ctxs) + max(ctxs))
+    runner = K2iRunner("cuda", max(ctxs))
+    raw, page = run_k2i(runner, case)
+    rows = case["q"].shape[0]
+    got = runner.logits(rows)
+    want = sglang_logits(case)
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
+    for t in range(rows):
+        b = int(case["bounds"][t])
+        if b <= 512:
+            continue
+        a, s = got[t, :b], want[t, :b]
+        scale = s.abs().max().clamp_min(1e-30)
+        assert torch.isfinite(a).all(), t
+        err = float((a - s).abs().max() / scale)
+        assert err <= 1e-5, (t, err)
+        cols = (
+            torch.randperm(b, generator=g, device="cuda")[:4096].int()
+            if b > 8192
+            else torch.arange(b, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        )
+        ref = ref_logits(case, t, cols)
+        err64 = float((a[cols.long()].double() - ref).abs().max() / ref.abs().max())
+        assert err64 <= 1e-5, (t, err64)
+    check_selection(case, got, raw, page)

+def _sets(a, b):
+    """Per-row Jaccard of two -1 padded id rows."""
+    out = []
+    for x, y in zip(a.tolist(), b.tolist()):
+        x, y = {v for v in x if v >= 0}, {v for v in y if v >= 0}
+        out.append(1.0 if not x and not y else len(x & y) / len(x | y))
+    return out
+

+def sglang_select(case, logits, two_level=None):
+    """SGLang's decode selection on ``logits``: plain paged top-k, the producer's candidate blocks, or (two_level =
+    its CandidateBlocks) the consumer's top-k inside them. -> (raw, page, candidates)."""
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.candidate_blocks_hip import (
+        select_candidate_blocks_hip,
+        topk_transform_paged_hip,
+        topk_within_candidate_blocks_hip,
+    )
+
+    rows = case["q"].shape[0]
+    raw = torch.empty(rows, 512, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    page = torch.empty_like(raw)
+    if two_level is not None:
+        topk_within_candidate_blocks_hip(logits, case["bounds"], two_level, page_table=case["table"], page_size=64,
+                                         page_indices=page, raw_indices=raw)  # fmt: skip
+        return raw, page, None
+    cands = select_candidate_blocks_hip(
+        logits, case["bounds"], topk_blocks=2048, block_size=8
+    )
+    topk_transform_paged_hip(logits, case["bounds"], case["table"], page, 64, raw)
+    return raw, page, cands
+

+"""CPU test of the monokernel plugin's contract with SGLang (RFC #43949 section 10): every module under
+kernels/ops/mono declares the SGLang names it imports in ``SGLANG_READS``, and every declared name still exists. An
+SGLang refactor that breaks the plugin fails here and names the file to repair."""
+
+import ast
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import sglang
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+ROOT = Path(sglang.__file__).parent
+PLUGIN = ROOT / "kernels/ops/mono"
+
+
+def srt_imports(tree: ast.Module) -> set[str]:
+    names = set()
+    for n in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and (n.module or "").startswith("sglang.srt"):
+            names |= {f"{n.module}.{a.name}" for a in n.names}
+        elif isinstance(n, ast.Import):
+            names |= {a.name for a in n.names if a.name.startswith("sglang.srt")}
+    return names
+
+
+def declared(tree: ast.Module) -> set[str]:
+    for n in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(
+            isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "SGLANG_READS" for t in n.targets
+        ):
+            return set(ast.literal_eval(n.value))
+    return set()
+
+
+def module_source(module: str):
+    rel = Path(*module.split(".")[1:])
+    for p in (ROOT / rel.with_suffix(".py"), ROOT / rel / "__init__.py"):
+        if p.is_file():
+            return p
+    return None
+
+
+def top_level_names(path: Path) -> set[str]:
+    out = set()
+    for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body:
+        if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
+            out.add(n.name)
+        elif isinstance(n, ast.Assign):
+            out |= {t.id for t in n.targets if isinstance(t, ast.Name)}
+        elif isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(n.target, ast.Name):
+            out.add(n.target.id)
+        elif isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
+            out |= {(a.asname or a.name).split(".")[0] for a in n.names}
+    return out
+
+
+class TestSglangReads(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_every_srt_import_is_declared(self):
+        for path in sorted(PLUGIN.rglob("*.py")):
+            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+            used, decl = srt_imports(tree), declared(tree)
+            rel = path.relative_to(ROOT)
+            self.assertEqual(used - decl, set(), f"{rel}: add these to SGLANG_READS")
+            self.assertEqual(
+                decl - used,
+                set(),
+                f"{rel}: SGLANG_READS lists names it no longer imports",
+            )
+
+    def test_every_declared_name_exists(self):
+        for path in sorted(PLUGIN.rglob("*.py")):
+            for name in sorted(declared(ast.parse(path.read_text()))):
+                module, _, attr = name.rpartition(".")
+                src = module_source(module)
+                self.assertIsNotNone(src, f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}: {module} is gone")
+                self.assertIn(
+                    attr,
+                    top_level_names(src),
+                    f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}: {name} is gone; repair this module",
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""CPU tests: the DeepSeek-V4.1 spec (whole layers) through the runtime, and the runtime itself free of model
+constants."""
+
+import ast
+import re
+import types
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono import runtime
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono import spec as spec_mod
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.spec import Exactness, MonoContext, check_spans, span_label
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+DSV41 = types.SimpleNamespace(
+    model_type="deepseek_v41",
+    hidden_size=5120,
+    n_routed_experts=384,
+    num_experts_per_tok=6,
+    moe_intermediate_size=2304,
+    n_shared_experts=1,
+    hc_mult=4,
+    scoring_func="sqrtsoftplus",
+    routed_scaling_factor=1.5,
+    hc_pre_from_prev_sublayer=True,
+    num_hidden_layers=40,
+)
+# some other MoE model's config: the V4.1 spec must refuse it
+OTHER = types.SimpleNamespace(
+    hidden_size=6144,
+    num_hidden_layers=60,
+    num_local_experts=128,
+    num_experts_per_tok=4,
+    num_attention_heads=64,
+    num_key_value_heads=4,
+    head_dim=128,
+    scoring_func="sigmoid",
+)
+CFG = types.SimpleNamespace(
+    tp_size=4, speculative_algorithm="DSPARK", enforce_shared_experts_fusion=False
+)
+
+
+def ctx(spec):
+    return MonoContext(
+        server_args=None,
+        hf_config=None,
+        tp_size=1,
+        tp_rank=0,
+        cpu_group=None,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        limits=spec.devices["gfx950"],
+    )
+
+
+def batch(mode, rows):
+    fm = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        is_decode=lambda: mode == "decode", is_target_verify=lambda: mode == "verify"
+    )
+    return types.SimpleNamespace(
+        forward_mode=fm, input_ids=torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.long), batch_size=1
+    )
+
+
+class TestSpecs(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.dsv41 = spec_mod.load_spec("DeepseekV41ForCausalLM")
+
+    def test_registry(self):
+        self.assertIs(spec_mod.load_spec("DeepseekV4ForCausalLM"), self.dsv41)
+        self.assertIsNone(spec_mod.load_spec("LlamaForCausalLM"))
+
+    def test_accepts_its_model_only(self):
+        import os
+
+        os.environ.setdefault("SGLANG_USE_AITER", "1")
+        self.assertEqual(self.dsv41.config_disable_reasons(CFG, DSV41), [])
+        self.assertTrue(self.dsv41.config_disable_reasons(CFG, OTHER))
+
+    def test_spans_and_widths(self):
+        spans = self.dsv41.spans(DSV41)
+        self.assertEqual(len(spans), 40)
+        self.assertEqual({span_label(s) for s in spans.values()}, {"whole"})
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {tuple(x.name for x in s) for s in spans.values()}, {("k1", "k2")}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(max(self.dsv41.devices["gfx950"].widths), 48)
+        c = ctx(self.dsv41)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(
+            runtime.decide_for_batch(self.dsv41, c, batch("verify", 48)).step
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            runtime.decide_for_batch(self.dsv41, c, batch("verify", 49)).reason,
+            "width",
+        )
+
+    def test_spans_and_numerics_agree(self):
+        spans = self.dsv41.spans(DSV41)
+        check_spans(spans)
+        names = {x.name for s in spans.values() for x in s}
+        for key in self.dsv41.numerics.bounds:
+            self.assertIn(key.split(".")[0], names, key)
+        self.assertIs(self.dsv41.numerics.exactness, Exactness.TOLERANCE)
+        self.assertTrue(self.dsv41.numerics.bounds)
+

+class TestWoARequant(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_bf16_wo_a_round_trips_to_checkpoint_mxfp8(self):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.mono.deepseek_v41_gfx950.spec import _mxfp8_blocks
+
+        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+        n, k = 64, 128
+        q = (
+            (torch.randn(n, k, generator=g) * 100)
+            .clamp(-448, 448)
+            .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        )
+        code = torch.randint(-20, 5, (n // 32, k // 32), generator=g).float()
+        scale = torch.exp2(code).repeat_interleave(32, 0).repeat_interleave(32, 1)
+        w = (q.float() * scale).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )  # what SGLang holds after its load-time dequant
+        q2, s2 = _mxfp8_blocks(w)
+        back = q2.float() * torch.exp2(s2.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(
+            32, 0
+        ).repeat_interleave(32, 1)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(back.to(torch.bfloat16), w))
+

+class TestRuntimeHasNoModelConstants(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_runtime_sources(self):
+        root = Path(spec_mod.__file__).parent
+        pattern = re.compile(
+            r"\b(5120|6144|384|deepseek|minimax|mhc|hc_mult|sinkhorn|dspark)\b", re.I
+        )
+        for name in (
+            "__init__.py",
+            "spec.py",
+            "guards.py",
+            "runtime.py",
+            "check.py",
+        ):
+            hits = [
+                ln
+                for ln in (root / name).read_text().splitlines()
+                if pattern.search(ln) and not ln.lstrip().startswith("#")
+            ]
+            self.assertEqual(hits, [], f"{name} mentions a model: {hits[:3]}")
+
+
+class TestFamiliesUseSharedCommon(CustomTestCase):
+    # same name, different helper: aiter's symbol namespace; the attention timeline's stamp(c, point)
+    ALLOWED = {
+        ("deepseek_v41_gfx950/attention/device.py", "kernel_symbol"),
+        ("deepseek_v41_gfx950/attention/device.py", "stamp"),
+    }
+
+    def test_no_family_redefines_a_shared_helper(self):
+        mono = Path(spec_mod.__file__).parent
+
+        def top_level(path):
+            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+            return {
+                n.name
+                for n in tree.body
+                if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))
+            }
+
+        shared = set().union(*map(top_level, (mono / "common_hip").rglob("*.py")))
+        families = [
+            d for d in mono.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and d.name.endswith("_gfx950")
+        ]
+        self.assertTrue(families)
+        clashes = sorted(
+            (str(f.relative_to(mono)), name)
+            for d in families
+            for f in d.rglob("*.py")
+            for name in top_level(f) & shared
+            if (str(f.relative_to(mono)), name) not in self.ALLOWED
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(clashes, [], "import these from common_hip instead")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
